entities.summary:
Ichasagua was a Guanche leader of the island of Tenerife, serving as the head of the Adeje nobility.




Ichasagua played a significant role in the politics and social hierarchy of the Guanche people, who inhabited the Canary Islands from the 5th century BCE to the 15th century CE.




His leadership and influence helped shape the Guanche culture and its relations with other pre-Columbian civilizations in the Mediterranean.




The legacy of Ichasagua can be seen in the ongoing cultural and historical heritage of the Canary Islands, particularly in the preservation of Guanche traditions and the study of their history and society.
